rationale: Price has gapped up 8% and is now trading well below both the session VWAP ($60.88) and the 9-EMA ($61.04), with the last five 1-minute candles showing a consistent downward drift from $60.70 to $59.91 on elevated volume in the final candle — suggesting distribution rather than a clean directional setup. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.26%, VIXY +7.65%), which adds headwind to any long thesis, while the stock is already 4% off its high with no clear support level established for a short entry. Without a defined structural level to lean against in either direction, the risk/reward does not justify commitment.
